newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto board approves payout for chemical spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto board approves payout for chemical spinoff.

text.p: Monsanto Co. said Tuesday its board of directors voted to give stockholders a stock dividend under a plan to spin off its chemical business into two publicly traded companies.

Under the spinoff proposal, which must be approved by the stockholders at a special meeting on Aug. 18, the shareholders will get one share of common stock in a new chemicals company for each five shares of Monsanto common stock held on Aug. 20.
Last December, Monsanto's board approved a plan to spin off the company's chemical businesses and form two companies.

One company, a life sciences company, will have $5 billion in sales and serve the agriculture, food and health care markets. The other company, a chemical company, will have about $3 billion in revenues and will make and market chemical based products.
Monsanto's stock was up 87.5 cents at $46.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
